description: This Java source file defines the EntityUtil class, providing helper methods for entity operations such as filtering, ordering, path generation, and date-based filtering within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper methods for entity operations such as filtering, ordering, path generation, and date-based filtering within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeFields
methods.description: Creates a map of string keys to values, expecting an array of key-value pairs where keys are strings.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first GenericValue from a collection or list, or null if empty.

methods.name: getOnly
methods.description: Returns the only GenericValue from a collection or list, throws exception if more than one.

methods.name: getFilterByDateExpr
methods.description: Creates an EntityCondition to filter by date, with overloads for different date parameters.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters a list of dated entities to those active at the current or specified moment.

methods.name: isValueActive
methods.description: Checks if a given GenericValue is active at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: filterByAnd
methods.description: Filters a list of entities matching all specified field-value pairs or conditions.

methods.name: filterByOr
methods.description: Filters a list of entities matching any of the specified conditions.

methods.name: localizedOrderBy
methods.description: Orders a collection of entities based on localized field values.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Orders a collection of entities based on specified order criteria.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities for a list of GenericValues, with optional caching.

methods.name: filterByCondition
methods.description: Filters entities matching a given EntityCondition.

methods.name: filterOutByCondition
methods.description: Filters entities not matching a given EntityCondition.

methods.name: findDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Finds entities with date inclusion filtering at current or specified timestamp.

methods.name: newDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Creates or updates a dated inclusion entity at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: delDatedInclusionEntity
methods.description: Marks a dated inclusion entity as ended by setting its 'thruDate'.

methods.name: getFieldListFromEntityList
methods.description: Extracts a list of field values from a list of GenericValues, with optional distinct filtering.

methods.name: getFieldListFromEntityListIterator
methods.description: Extracts a list of field values from an EntityListIterator, with optional distinct filtering.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldValueListFromEntityList
methods.description: Returns a list of entities with only selected fields.

methods.name: isMultiTenantEnabled
methods.description: Checks if multi-tenancy is enabled based on properties.

methods.name: getStartIndexFromViewIndex
methods.description: Calculates the start index for pagination based on view index and size.

methods.name: getPagedList
methods.description: Returns a paged subset of an EntityListIterator as a PagedList.

methods.name: entityToPath
methods.description: Generates a string path representing an entity and its primary key values.

methods.name: getPkValuesMapFromPath
methods.description: Parses a path string into a map of primary key names to values based on the entity model.
